items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: good lesser known musicians except for Duffy Jackson who was the drummer on it.

ctx.x: Did you mention to me you’d recorded some of your own material recently?

Within the last couple of years, yeah. I did I think seven originals out of twelve on this record I produced. And I wish I’d had a little more money to get a little better sound quality, but I’m funny that way. I’m very happy with it as far as at least having created myself an opportunity to do some writing and get some good musicians to play it — good lesser known musicians except for Duffy Jackson who was the drummer on it. Do you have a copy? I’ll give you one.
I would love to have one for our archive actually.
